title: Limits of the Greatest Integer Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate lim_{x -> 3^+} floor(x) and lim_{x -> 3^-} floor(x).

steps.title: Examine Values to the Right of 3
steps.explanation: For any x just greater than 3 (e.g. 3.01, 3.001), the greatest integer less than or equal to x is 3.
steps.why: Definition of the floor function for values in [3, 4).

steps.title: Evaluate the Right-Hand Limit
steps.explanation: The function is constant with value 3 on (3, 4).
steps.why: Limit of a constant function equals that constant.

steps.title: Examine Values to the Left of 3
steps.explanation: For any x just less than 3 (e.g. 2.99, 2.999), the greatest integer less than or equal to x is 2.
steps.why: Definition of the floor function for values in [2, 3).

steps.title: Evaluate the Left-Hand Limit
steps.explanation: The function is constant with value 2 on (2, 3).
steps.why: Limit of a constant function equals that constant.
